articles.summary: Rasha Hasaneen Chief Innovation and Growth Officer melody_admin Wed, 02/25/2026 - 13:20 Leader Rasha leads Vontier's innovation and growth functions and drives the company's enterprise innovation, AI strategy and digital modernization efforts. She is a globally recognized leader at the intersection of sustainability, technology and innovation. Her prior roles include various positions at Aspen Technology, Trane Technologies, General Electric, SAP and Hitachi, where she led complex product and portfolio transformations that delivered measurable business and customer impact. Hasaneen holds a Ph.D. in chemical engineering focused on sustainability from Texas A&M University and a master's degree in industrial engineering and engineering management from Stanford University. Image "Mobility is, and always has been, a driving force for innovation and is an industry that is poised to undergo significant transformation. With the rise of AI technology and the focus on energy expansion, transition and sustainability, our customers need a partner who can innovate with them to meet and exceed the needs of the market."
articles.title: Rasha Hasaneen

articles.summary: Courtney Kamlet Chief of Staff and Chief Governance Officer melody_admin Mon, 02/09/2026 - 13:21 Leader Courtney is an experienced Chief Governance Officer and Chief of Staff with over 25 years of experience advising C‑suite leaders and boards on complex governance, regulatory and compliance matters. She is adept at driving cross‑functional alignment on enterprise priorities, strengthening governance and decision‑making processes, and managing special projects and strategic initiatives to advance organizational outcomes. She is also a trusted leadership team member and advisor to boards on director oversight responsibilities and disclosure practices. Courtney holds a JD from the University of Florida, Fredric G. Levin College of Law and a BS in Psychology from the University of Florida. She currently resides in Greensboro, North Carolina with her family. Image I'm excited by Vontier's leadership in driving safe, sustainable, and connected mobility through disciplined governance and market-leading innovation that creates long-term value for our customers and employees.
articles.title: Courtney Kamlet
